mapper.select: SELECT id, business_number, company_name, ceo_name, address, industry, employee_count, annual_revenue, last_synced_at, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_som_company_snapshot WHERE business_number = #{businessNumber}

SELECT id, business_number, company_name, ceo_name, address, industry, employee_count, annual_revenue, last_synced_at, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_som_company_snapshot
(business_number LIKE '%' + #{keyword} + '%' OR company_name LIKE '%' + #{keyword} + '%')
ORDER BY last_synced_at DESC, id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tb_som_company_snapshot
(business_number LIKE '%' + #{keyword} + '%' OR company_name LIKE '%' + #{keyword} + '%')
mapper.update: MERGE tb_som_company_snapshot AS t USING (SELECT #{businessNumber} AS business_number, #{companyName} AS company_name, #{ceoName} AS ceo_name, #{address} AS address, #{industry} AS industry, #{employeeCount} AS employee_count, #{annualRevenue} AS annual_revenue ) AS s ON t.business_number = s.business_number WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET company_name = s.company_name, ceo_name = s.ceo_name, address = s.address, industry = s.industry, employee_count = s.employee_count, annual_revenue = s.annual_revenue, last_synced_at = SYSUTCDATETIME(), updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (business_number, company_name, ceo_name, address, industry, employee_count, annual_revenue, last_synced_at, created_at) VALUES (s.business_number, s.company_name, s.ceo_name, s.address, s.industry, s.employee_count, s.annual_revenue, SYSUTCDATETIME(), SYSUTCDATETIME());
